meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 uv 运行 Python，通过 DuckDB 或 Polars 处理 CSV、Parquet、JSON 等数据文件。它会根据操作类型自动选择工具，执行筛选、排序、分组、连接等，并输出结果或图表。不依赖 pandas。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析数据、查看文件内容，或提到分组、筛选、汇总等操作时触发；涉及 .csv/.parquet/.json 等数据文件时也会激活。纯文本/代码检查、配置文件或简单计算不触发。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV 文件，按类别汇总金额
say.note: 会触发数据分析和聚合

say.text: 比较昨天和今天的数据趋势
合并两个数据集并筛选金额大于100的行

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses uv to run Python and processes CSV, Parquet, JSON files with DuckDB or Polars. It automatically selects the right tool for filtering, sorting, grouping, joining, etc., and outputs results or charts. Never uses pandas.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze data, inspect file contents, or mentions grouping/filtering/summarizing, or data files like .csv/.parquet/.json. Not for plain text/code inspection, configs, or small inline math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and summarize amounts by category.
Compare yesterday's and today's data trends.
Merge two datasets and filter rows with amount > 100.
